data.name: Sabri
data.gender_notes: Sabri is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has patience and endurance, especially in times of hardship and difficulty. The name Sabri carries the meaning “Patience, Endurance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Turkish. Parents who choose Sabri usually hope their child will grow to embody patience, endurance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek spiritual growth and understanding through patience and perseverance.
data.etymology: Sabri belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patience, Endurance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabri total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The name Sabri is a reminder of the virtue of sabr (patience) and inspires those who bear it to embody this noble characteristics in their daily lives.

The name Sabri is a constant reminder to those who bear it to be patient, seek Allah's help and guidance, and trust in His divine plan, even in times of difficulties.
